=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_chatgpt_reviewer_slot.py:124 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The new test test_shipped_pool_config_file_exists_and_keeps_the_slot_off asserts that `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` exists (POOL_CONFIG, defined at line 40), but the PR never adds that file.
  WHY: The test fails on every run; CI on head 245a4912 shows "AssertionError: missing shipped switch file: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json" (1 failed, 87 passed), so the issue's acceptance command fails. The fix is to add the file, not to weaken the test. The reviewer rated this BLOCKER, mapped here to critical.
- changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-config-file.md:2 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment says `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` is committed and resolves to `enabled=false reason=switch_off`, but the PR does not add the file.
  WHY: Without the file, claude_engine.py chatgpt-slot records config_missing (scripts/claude_engine.py line 243), not switch_off (line 284), so the release note is false. This has the same root cause as the missing file; the fragment text should stay. Copilot reported the same mismatch inline. The reviewer rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Create `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` with exactly the plan's content, JSON, 2-space indentation, trailing newline: {"reviewer_slot_enabled": false, "model": "gpt-6-sol", "replaces": "openai/gpt-6-luna", "reasoning": "xhigh"}. `reviewer_slot_enabled` MUST stay `false`." This is also the first acceptance criterion and the first files_touched entry.
  expected_change_site: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json (new file)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The PR changes only changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-config-file.md and tests/test_review_chatgpt_reviewer_slot.py. No hunk creates .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json, a glob of .github/ai/* on the current ref returns only .github/ai/claude_engine.json, and the new test and acceptance pytest command fail, as the CI check-run confirms.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_review_chatgpt_reviewer_slot.py:124 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test asserts POOL_CONFIG.is_file() (POOL_CONFIG = REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "ai" / "chatgpt_pool.json", line 40), but the PR never adds the file. Only claude_engine.json exists in .github/ai/, and no .gitignore rule excludes the path.
  WHY: It always fails. The CI tests-hooks-and-orchestrator check on head 245a4912 shows "AssertionError: missing shipped switch file: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json" (1 failed, 87 passed). The PR body's pre-push gate lists it under "Failures caused by this change". The fix is to add the file with the issue's exact content and leave the test as it is.
- changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-config-file.md:2 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The fragment says the switch file ships and resolves to `enabled=false reason=switch_off`, but the PR does not add it. Copilot's inline comment on line 2 reports the same mismatch.
  WHY: Without the file, chatgpt-slot records config_missing (scripts/claude_engine.py line 243) instead of switch_off (line 284). This has the same root cause as the finding above; adding the file fixes it, and the fragment text should stay.
- Note: The reviewer did not report Copilot's line-127 suggestion that `shipped == json.loads(SHIPPED_CONFIG)` is brittle, because issue #9111 item 2 explicitly requires that equality.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Create `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` with exactly the plan's content, JSON, 2-space indentation, trailing newline: {"reviewer_slot_enabled": false, "model": "gpt-6-sol", "replaces": "openai/gpt-6-luna", "reasoning": "xhigh"}. `reviewer_slot_enabled` MUST stay `false`." This is also the first acceptance criterion and the first files_touched entry.
  Expected change site: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json (new file, 2-space indentation, trailing newline)
  Evidence of absence: The PR changes only changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-config-file.md and tests/test_review_chatgpt_reviewer_slot.py. No hunk creates the file, and a glob of .github/ai/* returns only .github/ai/claude_engine.json. The new test and acceptance pytest command fail, as the CI check-run confirms.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0
